name: prompt-767
image_purpose: Creative conceptual post and surreal dream visual

prompt.project_info: Create a whimsical mixed-media composition blending realistic top-down photography with playful white line-art doodles, depicting an approved adult sleeping and dreaming of a deep-sea scuba adventure.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with long blonde hair, a relaxed sleeping expression, fair natural skin texture, and a pink bikini. She sleeps peacefully on her side in a fetal-like position with legs slightly bent and hands curled near the chest or face. Drawn scuba mask, tank, regulator, fins, fish, bubbles, coral, seaweed, and starfish overlay the photograph.
prompt.composition_elements: Top-down 90-degree bird's-eye view over a cozy bed, subject centered or slightly diagonal, wrinkled teal or aquamarine bedding as the canvas, flat field focus across the bedding, white hand-drawn line art integrated with the sleeping figure. Square 1:1 composition at 1440x1440px.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft cool ambient moonlight or diffused overhead fill, moderate dimensional shadows on bedding, cool cyan and navy nocturnal palette, serene underwater-dream mood.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution digital mirrorless or smartphone-style top-down photograph, 35mm or 50mm standard lens look, 1:1, smooth photographic texture for the subject and bedding, rough chalk or marker texture for doodles.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Whimsical mixed-media square 1:1 top-down photograph of an approved adult woman with long blonde hair sleeping peacefully on her side in a fetal-like position on a cozy bed, wearing a pink bikini. Teal and aquamarine wrinkled bedding forms the canvas. Superimpose distinct scribbly white hand-drawn line art of a scuba mask over the eyes, air tank, regulator, fins, bubbles, fish, coral, seaweed, and starfish, making the subject dream of an underwater adventure. Cool moonlight, soft dimensional shadows, cyan and navy nocturnal palette, realistic sleeping figure and bedding blended with playful chalk-like doodles, 1440x1440px.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, erotic framing, exposed intimate areas, minors, waking subject, standing, real scuba gear, 3D doodles, realistic drawn props, warm sunlight, orange tones, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra limbs, distorted hands, watermark, invented text

assets.name: prompt-767.jpg
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult's sleeping pose, pink bikini, teal bedding, white doodle style, scuba drawing placement, fish, coral, bubbles, fins, and underwater color palette.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve identity consistency, sleeping pose, wardrobe, bedding, doodle treatment, and color palette. The person, clothing, bedding, and illustration elements are replaceable assets only if the same mixed-media dream composition remains. Do not invent typography or logos; keep the overlay as white line art only.
